items.effect: approximated: flattened, the placeholder keeps the position and size it inherits as its own
items.label: placeholder(s) that take their position from the layout (flattened on import)

items.effect: kept: the clip and its poster frame are stored unchanged, kept for saving back; the editor shows the poster in a labelled placeholder and does not play it (linked clips are never fetched)
items.label: audio or video clip(s)
